_meta.status: placeholder research instrument; not for clinical use

bnp_lo.statement: the patient has BNP less than 100 pg/mL
bnp_lo.bears_on: the patient has cardiogenic pulmonary edema

bnp_grey.statement: the patient has BNP between 100 and 500 pg/mL
bnp_grey.bears_on: the patient has cardiogenic pulmonary edema

bnp_mod.statement: the patient has BNP between 500 and 900 pg/mL
bnp_mod.bears_on: the patient has cardiogenic pulmonary edema

bnp_hi.statement: the patient has BNP between 900 and 5000 pg/mL
bnp_hi.bears_on: the patient has cardiogenic pulmonary edema

bnp_vhi.statement: the patient has BNP greater than 5000 pg/mL
bnp_vhi.bears_on: the patient has cardiogenic pulmonary edema

pf_normal.statement: the patient has a PaO2/FiO2 ratio greater than 300
pf_normal.bears_on: the patient has acute respiratory distress syndrome

pf_mild.statement: the patient has a PaO2/FiO2 ratio of 200-300
pf_mild.bears_on: the patient has acute respiratory distress syndrome

pf_mod.statement: the patient has a PaO2/FiO2 ratio of 100-200
pf_mod.bears_on: the patient has acute respiratory distress syndrome

pf_severe.statement: the patient has a PaO2/FiO2 ratio less than 100
pf_severe.bears_on: the patient has acute respiratory distress syndrome

rs_hfnc.statement: the patient receives high-flow nasal cannula at over 30 L/min and over 50% FiO2
rs_hfnc.bears_on: the patient has acute respiratory distress syndrome

rs_niv.statement: the patient receives non-invasive ventilation with PEEP over 5 cmH2O
rs_niv.bears_on: the patient has acute respiratory distress syndrome

rs_imvlow.statement: the patient receives invasive ventilation with PEEP 5-10 cmH2O
rs_imvlow.bears_on: the patient has acute respiratory distress syndrome

rs_imvmiddle.statement: the patient receives invasive ventilation with PEEP 10-15 cmH2O
rs_imvmiddle.bears_on: the patient has acute respiratory distress syndrome

rs_imvhigh.statement: the patient receives invasive ventilation with PEEP over 15 cmH2O
rs_imvhigh.bears_on: the patient has acute respiratory distress syndrome

ef_preserved.statement: the patient has left ventricular ejection fraction of 50% or higher on echocardiogram
ef_preserved.bears_on: the patient has cardiogenic pulmonary edema

ef_mid.statement: the patient has left ventricular ejection fraction of 40-49% on echocardiogram
ef_mid.bears_on: the patient has cardiogenic pulmonary edema

ef_reduced.statement: the patient has left ventricular ejection fraction of 30-39% on echocardiogram
ef_reduced.bears_on: the patient has cardiogenic pulmonary edema

ef_severe.statement: the patient has left ventricular ejection fraction below 30% on echocardiogram
ef_severe.bears_on: the patient has cardiogenic pulmonary edema

bi_min.statement: the patient has subtle or limited bilateral pulmonary infiltrates on imaging

bi_mod.statement: the patient has moderate bilateral pulmonary infiltrates on imaging

bi_diffuse.statement: the patient has extensive, diffuse bilateral airspace opacities on imaging

bp_partial.statement: the patient has partial perihilar predominance of pulmonary infiltrates on imaging

bp_classic.statement: the patient has a classic bat-wing distribution of pulmonary infiltrates on imaging

kb_present.statement: the patient has Kerley B lines on chest imaging

pv_none.statement: the patient has no pleural effusions
pv_none.bears_on: the patient has cardiogenic pulmonary edema

pv_small.statement: the patient has small bilateral pleural effusions
pv_small.bears_on: the patient has cardiogenic pulmonary edema

pv_mod.statement: the patient has moderate bilateral pleural effusions
pv_mod.bears_on: the patient has cardiogenic pulmonary edema

pv_large.statement: the patient has large bilateral pleural effusions
pv_large.bears_on: the patient has cardiogenic pulmonary edema

cd_cardiotox.statement: the patient recently received chemotherapy with a cardiotoxic agent such as an anthracycline or trastuzumab

cd_pneumotox.statement: the patient recently received chemotherapy with a pneumotoxic agent such as bleomycin, gemcitabine, or methotrexate

fluid_neg.statement: the patient received diuretics in the past 24 hours and has a negative fluid balance
fluid_neg.bears_on: the patient has cardiogenic pulmonary edema

fluid_pos.statement: the patient received moderate-volume intravenous fluids and had a moderately positive fluid balance in the past 24 hours
fluid_pos.bears_on: the patient has cardiogenic pulmonary edema

fluid_verypos.statement: the patient received large-volume intravenous fluids and had a very positive fluid balance in the past 24 hours
fluid_verypos.bears_on: the patient has cardiogenic pulmonary edema

tr_minor.statement: the patient sustained recent minor or isolated trauma

tr_major.statement: the patient sustained recent major multisystem trauma

cv_minor.statement: the patient has cardiovascular risk factors or treated hypertension

cv_struct.statement: the patient has a known history of structural heart disease or prior heart failure

pna_focal.statement: the patient has lobar or unilateral pneumonia

pna_multifocal.statement: the patient has multilobar or bilateral pneumonia

asp.statement: the patient has a documented aspiration event

rf.statement: the patient has acute renal failure with volume overload

septic_shock.statement: the patient has documented septic shock

pe.statement: the patient has acute pulmonary embolism

cpe.statement: the patient has cardiogenic pulmonary edema

ards.statement: the patient has acute respiratory distress syndrome
